title: Fatal Reservations by Lucy Burdette
description:
Novels & Nibbles is blending a cozy mystery with the colorful island of Key West so throw on your flip flops and sunscreen because here we go. This week’s book follows food critic Hayley Snow, whose job is usually all about tasting menus and writing reviews… until real-life trouble crashes the table when a flamboyant tarot card/palm reader/mystic is murdered, Hayley’s friend Lorenzo becomes the prime suspect. So she swaps her fork for sleuthing and dives into an ocean of rivalries, secrets, and island drama to prove his innocence. Along the way, there’s plenty of food (i.e. Fried Green Tomatoes), friendship tension, and the ever-present question: who’s really telling the truth? 

Our Fried Green Tomatoes are straight out of a mystery worth savoring, and we are allowing our guests to taste a clue straight from the plot!! Ewww. Exciting! Fried green tomatoes, crisped in a golden coat of spiced saltines, crowned with our Nana’s homemade pimento cheese recipe and bourbon bacon jam.

This Fried Green Tomatoes dish is to die for. And, yes, we mean that literally. Come taste the story.
